name: Pyralinks
summary: Pyralinks is a free daily puzzle game. Each puzzle is a pyramid of items (words, word fragments, or numbers), and your goal is to rearrange them so that every connected pair forms a valid link. An item has to work with the one above it and the ones below it at the same time, so a swap that fixes one link can break another. There is a new puzzle every day, and everyone plays the same one.
